title: Melike Turgut — gummy wordmark
note: A 48-hour Halloween reskin: her name-pun wordmark built from glossy jelly/gummy icons that stretch gooey strings when dragged, each icon one of her 8 chapters. Her version: keep the jelly material and sticky drag, swap in motifs from her own drawings (pigeon, matcha cup, pencil, headphones, camera, flower), make the charms functional navigation, and reskin the set for occasions. Site (permanent version, already in the repo as the charm wordmark): https://www.meliketurgut.com/
